title: internal/exec/subprocess tests do not build at base: the gate is red for every tick
body: report_archive_test.go:105 references fileReportArchive, but the constant was exported as FileReportArchive in state.go by commit 842b627 (tick nvn); commit 48f844d added the test using the stale unexported name, so `go test ./internal/exec/subprocess` fails to compile at 6d59366f7c67 and the gate command (.tick/runners.toml: go test -short -count=1 -timeout 45m -parallel 12 ./...) cannot pass for ANY tick in this epic. The fix is the one-word rename in the test; it was not made here because the package is outside emk's scope and the change could not be attributed to this tick.
